punchline: The urge for one more clip arrives right after the pleasure, and Lembke says it fades if she waits.
thirty_sec: Anna Lembke uses her own habit of watching American Idol clips to explain the pleasure-pain balance: each clip tips the brain toward pleasure, then gremlins hop onto the pain side to level it. If she waits, they leave. If she keeps watching, they pile up until she needs the clips just to feel normal.
question: Next time the pull toward one more arrives, what could you do for ten minutes instead of giving in?
key_contrast: Waiting lets the comedown pass; more of the same makes it heavier.
